-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check. Verifies MongoDB connectivity. Use `get-stats` for per-user active counts.

get-stats.name: get-stats
get-stats.description: Live counters for the current user: active reminders, active recurring tasks, and next scheduled run timestamp.

parse-time-expression.name: parse-time-expression
parse-time-expression.description: Preview a time/cron expression without scheduling. Returns parsed timestamp, humanReadable, and next occurrences.

params.expression: Natural language ("in 2 hours", "tomorrow at 9am", ISO) or cron ("0 9 * * 1-5").

schedule-reminder.name: schedule-reminder
schedule-reminder.description: Schedule a one-shot reminder. time: natural ("in 2 hours", "tomorrow at 9am") or ISO 8601. timezone defaults to env. Returns the new reminder.

params.channelId: Channel that receives the wake event (must be owned by user).
params.allowPast: Allow scheduling in the past (default false).
params.idempotencyKey: Optional idempotency key. If a reminder with the same key+user already exists, returns it instead of creating a duplicate.

list-reminders.name: list-reminders
list-reminders.description: List reminders of the current user, paginated. Filter by channelId or status. Returns {items[], nextCursor?}.

list-upcoming.name: list-upcoming
list-upcoming.description: List upcoming reminders and recurring tasks of the current user within a window (default 7 days). include: reminders|recurring|both. Paginated.

get-reminder.name: get-reminder
get-reminder.description: Get a reminder by ID (must belong to current user). Returns full reminder with humanReadable next-run.

update-reminder.name: update-reminder
update-reminder.description: Update a pending reminder of the current user. Provide time (re-parsed) or message (or both). Cancelled/sent reminders are not editable.

params.reminderId: ID of the reminder to update.

snooze-reminder.name: snooze-reminder
snooze-reminder.description: Postpone a pending reminder of the current user by a delay (e.g. "30m", "2h", "1d"). Adds delay on top of current time.

params.reminderId: ID of the reminder to snooze.

cancel-reminder.name: cancel-reminder
cancel-reminder.description: Cancel a pending reminder of the current user. Idempotent (returns noop if already cancelled). Cleans up channel subscription if last one.

params.reminderId: ID of the reminder to cancel.

bulk-cancel.name: bulk-cancel
bulk-cancel.description: Bulk-cancel pending reminders of the current user. Filter by channelId, before (ISO or epoch ms), or ids[]. Returns cancelled IDs and cleans subs for channels with no remaining pending.

params.channelId: Cancel all pending in this channel.
params.before: Cancel pending scheduled before this time (ISO 8601 or epoch ms).

create-recurring-task.name: create-recurring-task
create-recurring-task.description: Create a recurring task using a 5-field cron expression. Examples: "0 9 * * *", "*/15 * * * *", "0 10-22 * * 1-5". timezone defaults to env.

params.cronExpression: Cron 5 fields: "min hour day month weekday".
params.message: Message delivered on each run (max 4000 chars).
params.channelId: Channel that receives the wake event (must be owned by user).
params.idempotencyKey: Optional idempotency key. If a recurring task with the same key+user already exists, returns it instead of creating a duplicate.

list-recurring-tasks.name: list-recurring-tasks
list-recurring-tasks.description: List recurring tasks of the current user, paginated. Filter by channelId or enabled. Returns {items[], nextCursor?}.

get-recurring-task.name: get-recurring-task
get-recurring-task.description: Get a recurring task by ID (must belong to current user). Returns full task with cronDescription and humanReadable next-run.

update-recurring-task.name: update-recurring-task
update-recurring-task.description: Update a recurring task of the current user. Provide cronExpression (re-validates and recomputes nextRun), message, or timezone.

enable-recurring-task.name: enable-recurring-task
enable-recurring-task.description: Enable (resume) a recurring task of the current user. Recomputes nextRun. Idempotent if already enabled.

disable-recurring-task.name: disable-recurring-task
disable-recurring-task.description: Disable (pause) a recurring task of the current user. Idempotent if already disabled.

delete-recurring-task.name: delete-recurring-task
delete-recurring-task.description: Permanently delete a recurring task of the current user. Cleans up channel subscription if last one for the channel.

list-executions.name: list-executions
list-executions.description: List execution history of a recurring task of the current user. Most recent first. Returns {items[], nextCursor?}.

name: Scheduler & Reminders
description: Schedule reminders and recurring tasks. Natural language times (chrono-node, en+es) and cron expressions (croner). Timezone-aware.

changelog.notes: Initial release — schedule, snooze, and cancel one-time reminders and recurring tasks using plain-language or cron times, timezone-aware
